author: ValWood
body:
* **ARBA rule (ID and label):**


GO:0006139 | nucleobase-containing compound metabolic process | IEA with ARBA00026572


* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

rib2

* **Description of issue**

Riboflavin isn't a nucleobase or nucleotide. Its core structure is a flavin ring, not a purine or pyrimidine base.
title: GO:0006139	 nucleobase-containing compound metabolic process IEA with ARBA00026572

author: claude[bot]
source_title: Critical review of ARBA00026572: Recommend immediate deprecation of overly complex nucleobase metabolism mega-rule

author: Antonialock
body:
this rule applies this term to fungal proteins that match interpro IPR016193 https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb?query=%28xref%3Ainterpro-IPR016193%29+AND+%28taxonomy_id%3A4751%29

nucleobase-containing compound metabolic process looks correct for all but pombe rib2 - cerevisiae rib2 is bifunctional and the term is correct for the "second function"
I will curate A, oryzae rib2, it also matches this interpro, so this should invalidate the rule (the rule will no longer be true for all SP entries with EXP annotation), the paper describes crystal structures of this protein so it could potentially be interesting.

however, I'm wondering if the annotation is meaningful at all, do you think I can ask for the do_not_annotate flag for these terms?:

GO:0006139 nucleobase-containing compound metabolic process 36,354 ARBA annotations
GO:0034654 nucleobase-containing compound biosynthetic process  8,029 ARBA  annotations
GO:0034655 nucleobase-containing compound catabolic process  382 ARBA annotations
GO:0019219 regulation of nucleobase-containing compound metabolic process  6,887 ARBA annotations
GO:0045934 negative regulation of nucleobase-containing compound metabolic process 1,080 ARBA annotations
GO:0080090 regulation of primary metabolic process  120,144 ARBA annotations (primary nonregulatory term is already do not annotate)

author: ValWood
body:
Personally, I think these could be blocked. For example the first one

GO:0006139 nucleobase-containing compound metabolic process 36,354 ARBA annotations
has only 15 EXP annotations. These aren't useful annotations  for IEA and  it should be possible to make more specific annotations.
